registration.statement: A local solid defect is the exact interruption between one complete reference-site motif and one complete observed motif. A vacancy is a retained reference site with structural EmptyOne occupancy. Missing and added species are separate positive supports, never a signed difference; their primitive count vectors force exact reference and observed formulas, defect class and intrinsic/extrinsic origin.
